families.description: Soprano is an ultra-lightweight (~80M) English-only text-to-speech model. Syntax uses a 17-layer Qwen3-style causal LM (hidden 512, vocab 8192) that autoregressively emits per-frame 512-dimensional features; a non-iterative Vocos-style decoder (ConvNeXt backbone + single ISTFT head, n_fft 2048 / hop 512) turns those features into 32 kHz audio. No diffusion refinement is performed in the decoder.
